name: Template studio fills a selected HTML template with AI-generated slides
description: Selecting a template, writing a brief and clicking the AI fill button streams slide generation and opens the deck viewer with the finished slides.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and click the 'Template studio — HTML decks' mode switch tab.
In the 'Pick a template' gallery type 'biennale' into the search box and click the single matching template card to select it.
Clear the search box. In the Brief textarea type: 'Museum exhibition opening announcement: featured artists, dates, ticket info and highlights'.
Click the generate button labelled like 'Fill "…" with AI' (the exact label includes the selected template name).
Verify a progress indicator appears while the deck is being built (a 'BUILDING YOUR DECK' style progress or streaming status).
Within 180 seconds verify the deck viewer opens showing the finished deck: a slide counter (like '01 / N'), navigation controls and a 'Present' button.
Verify the viewer displays a rendered slide that reflects the selected template's visual design (distinct background/styling, not a blank white page).
Verify export controls are available in the viewer, including 'PNG · this slide'.
